newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Dec export prices fall 0.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Dec export prices fall 0.1 pct.

text.p: Australia's export prices fell 0.1 percent in December from the previous month, and were 6.2 percent lower than a year before, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.
"Wheat prices fell during the month, reflecting increased supply worldwide," the bureau said in a statement.
"Partially offsetting these decreases were price increases for aluminium and aluminium products and mineral fuels and oils, following world trends."
The biggest monthly fall was in vegetable products, which declined 4.5 percent over the month, for an annual decrease of 11.1 percent.
Base metals increased 1.8 percent for the month, but were 17.1 percent lower than a year earlier, the largest annual fall in the 10 categories that make up the index.
The index fell in all but two months of calendar 1996.
